items.heading: The place is a community that happens to rent desks
items.subheading: Told at every table that talked about why anyone stays. The desks are the invoice; the recognition is the product. Whenever this story is in the room, spending on the café, the welcome and the programme reads as core cost rather than overhead.

items.heading: The place is a quiet room people pay to protect
items.subheading: Held mostly by full-rate members and rarely said first, because it sounds ungenerous next to the community story. It surfaces the moment anything proposes opening the building further, and it is the reason the ground-floor question keeps failing to close.

items.heading: The place is being run on somebody else's terms
items.subheading: Grant conditions set the reporting, the funders set the calendar, the board holds the accounts. This story explains why the staff table proposed no new work of its own, and why governance questions kept arriving as fatigue rather than as proposals.
